title: Paystride Visa Payroll Card as a Payout Destination — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Desk Guidance
content:
A worker who holds a Paystride Visa Payroll Card changes how a payout on the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service can reach them.

**The rule the desk applies.** The worker's Paystride card is offered as a payout destination only while that card account's status is active; a worker whose card is issued but not activated, blocked or closed is paid to an external debit card or bank account instead, at that destination's fee, and the card's status never limits a payout to an external destination. A payout to the card costs the tier's fee per payout to a Paystride Visa Payroll Card and posts on the card as an instant pay load.

## The card account's status and the destinations open

| Status of the worker's Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account | Paystride card offered as a destination | External debit card or bank account |
|---|---|---|
| active | yes | available, at that destination's fee |
| issued, not activated | no | available, at that destination's fee |
| blocked | no | available, at that destination's fee |
| closed | no | available, at that destination's fee |

## Questions the rule answers

**Does a blocked card stop a payout to the worker's own bank account?** No. The card's status never limits a payout to an external destination; the payout to the bank account is made at that destination's fee.

**What does a payout to an active card cost, and how does the worker see it?** It costs the tier's fee per payout to a Paystride Visa Payroll Card, and it posts on the card as an instant pay load.

**A worker's card was issued but has not been activated. Can the payout go to it?** No. Until the card account is active the worker is paid to an external debit card or bank account, at that destination's fee.
